d: Shortly after take-off, there was a loud thud, followed by a continual thumping noise on Flight ASA 529. One of the propeller blades was now a stub and the engine was glued to the left wing.
An Air France Airbus carrying 180 people was hijacked by four Algerian terrorists just before take off. They demanded the release from prison of Muslim leaders held by the Algerian authorities.
A lone air traffic controller failed to notice that a Russian plane was on a collision course with a DHL cargo plane. The planes crashed into each other, killing all 71 people.
As American Airlines Flight 965 prepares to descend, an alarm sounds in the cockpit. The aircraft slams into the top of a mountain, disintegrating on contact. Only four people survive the crash.
Avianca Airlines Flight 52 was low on fuel and they hadn’t received word to approach JFK yet. The plane ran out of fuel, and the engines shut down. It crashed in a suburb killing 73 people.
Flight 243 from Maui to Honolulu loses a chunk of its roof mid-flight, but lands safely. The cause is linked to the disappearance of a flight attendant.
DHL A300's crew battles to land for 16 min at Baghdad's airport without hydraulics during a routine mail run.
Minutes after take off from Tokyo en route to Osaka, the tailfin blows off the huge Boeing 747. The plane is now out of control.
The three man crew of FedEx 705 are just finishing their climb out from Memphis when the attack starts.
During a sea battle, a military radar operator mistakenly identifies an approaching civilian aircraft as a hostile F-14.
An explosion jolts the pilots of PA 434. A bomb has gone off and there’s extensive damage to the plane.
During extreme weather conditions, a Super Puma helicopter makes a routine journey to a North Sea oil platform.
When a Boeing 767 slams into the Atlantic Ocean off the coast of Nantucket, killing all 217 people on-board, the questions start flying.
RIA Flight 593 from Moscow to Hong Kong was routine in every respect. Then, in less than five minutes, it fell from the sky. There was distress call.
115 people on board a VIA passenger train on February 8, 1986, a pleasant trip would turn into a horrifying nightmare.
On September 26, 2000, the Greek ferry “Express Samina” was sailing through the Aegean Sea, heading for the island of Paros.
One of the largest train disasters in U.S history. A freight train rumbling through the suburb derails and crashes, destroying homes and taking lives.
